const startupStats = $('Compute Startup Stats & Chart').first().json.stats;
const customerStats = $('Compute Customer Stats & Chart').first().json.stats;
const useCaseStats = $('Compute UseCase Stats & Chart').first().json.stats;

const monthlyRegChartUrl = $('Upload Startup Growth Chart').first().json.permalink;
const topLocationsChartUrl = $('Upload Country Chart').first().json.permalink;
const topStartupsChartUrl = $('Upload Top Startups Chart').first().json.permalink;
const customerChartUrl = $('Upload Customer Growth Chart').first().json.permalink;
const useCaseChartUrl = $('Upload UseCase Views Chart').first().json.permalink;
const useCaseMonthlyChartUrl = $('Upload UseCase Monthly Chart').first().json.permalink;

const now = new Date().toISOString();

const statusLines = Object.entries(useCaseStats.byStatus).map(([status, count]) => `- ${status}: ${count}`).join('\n');

const conversionRate = customerStats.totalCustomers > 0
  ? ((customerStats.subscribed / customerStats.totalCustomers) * 100).toFixed(1)
  : '0.0';

const canvasContent = [
  '# AI Ecosystem Analytics Dashboard',
  '',
  `Report Generated: ${now}`,
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# STARTUP ECOSYSTEM',
  '',
  `**Total startups:** ${startupStats.totalStartups} (excl. test accounts)`,
   `**Startups with 0 use cases:** ${startupStats.startupsWithZeroUseCases} (registered but no submission yet)`,
  '',
  '## Top locations',
  `![Top locations](${topLocationsChartUrl})`,
  '',
  '## Top 10 startups by use cases linked',
  `![Top startups by use cases](${topStartupsChartUrl})`,
  '',
  '## Monthly registrations',
  `![Monthly registrations](${monthlyRegChartUrl})`,
  '',
  '_Counts reflect startup registration date only — not when use cases were submitted._',
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# AI USE CASE INTELLIGENCE',
  '',
  `**Total Use Cases:** ${useCaseStats.totalUseCases}`,
  '',
  statusLines,
  '',
  '## Top 10 Use Cases by Views',
  `![Top Use Cases](${useCaseChartUrl})`,
  '',
  '## Use Case Monthly Trend',
  `![Use Case Monthly Trend](${useCaseMonthlyChartUrl})`,
  '',
  '_Counts reflect use case creation date only — not when approval status changed._',
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# CUSTOMER INSIGHTS',
  '',
  `**Total Customers:** ${customerStats.totalCustomers}`,
  `- Subscribed: ${customerStats.subscribed} (${conversionRate}% conversion)`,
  `- Not subscribed: ${customerStats.notSubscribed}`,
  '',
  '## Customer Monthly Growth',
  `![Customer Growth](${customerChartUrl})`,
  ''
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { canvasContent } }];

parameters.content:
## Platform Statistics - Fully Automated (Charts, no Claude step)

Fetches startups/customers/use-cases -> computes stats -> renders REAL chart images via QuickChart.io -> uploads to Slack channel testing-channel -> replaces canvas <SLACK_ID> (new canvas, created for this workflow) with embedded charts.

This is a brand-new workflow. It does NOT modify or touch '1- Platform Statistics', '2- Favro Statistics', or '3- Google Analytics Statistics'.

⚠️ API TOKEN EXPIRES ~AUG 7, 2026

This is a hardcoded JWT (same pattern as the original workflow). No login/refresh endpoint was found. Update this node's "token" value before it expires, or the daily run will fail silently.

## Chart rendering

Each QuickChart node POSTs a Chart.js config to quickchart.io/chart (no auth needed) and gets back a real PNG. The Slack node then uploads that PNG and returns a permalink used in the final canvas markdown.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { canvas_id: "<SLACK_ID>", changes: [ { operation: "replace", document_content: { type: "markdown", markdown: $json.canvasContent } } ] } }}
